```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Updated period colours
period_colours <- c(
  "Pre-fire"              = "darkolivegreen",
  "During Fire / Recovery" = "#BF812D",
  "Post-fire"             = "#01665E"
)

# Partition Calperum by fire period 
cpr <- sites_daily_capped[["Cpr"]] %>%
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date))

cpr_pre    <- cpr %>% filter(year >= 2010 & year <= 2013)
cpr_during <- cpr %>% filter(year >= 2014 & year <= 2019)
cpr_post   <- cpr %>% filter(year >= 2020 & year <= 2025)

# Run slope fitting per period 
fit_vpd_slope <- function(df, period_name) {
  
  binned <- df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n       = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  vpd_at_peak <- binned$vpd_mid[which.max(binned$gpp_norm)]
  descending  <- binned %>% filter(vpd_mid >= vpd_at_peak)
  
  if (nrow(descending) < 3) {
    return(tibble(period = period_name, intercept = NA, slope = NA,
                  vpd_at_peak = NA, n_bins = nrow(descending)))
  }
  
  model <- lm(gpp_norm ~ vpd_mid, data = descending)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  tibble(
    period      = period_name,
    intercept   = coefs[1],
    slope       = coefs[2],
    vpd_at_peak = vpd_at_peak,
    n_bins      = nrow(descending)
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Apply to each period 
calperum_slopes <- bind_rows(
  fit_vpd_slope(cpr_pre,    "Pre-fire"),
  fit_vpd_slope(cpr_during, "During Fire / Recovery"),
  fit_vpd_slope(cpr_post,   "Post-fire")
) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c(
    "Pre-fire",
    "During Fire / Recovery",
    "Post-fire"
  )))

print(calperum_slopes)

# Build binned point cloud per period 
make_cloud <- function(df, period_name) {
  
  cap <- quantile(df$GPP, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  df  <- df %>% mutate(GPP = ifelse(GPP > cap, NA, GPP))
  
  df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n       = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(
      gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE),
      period   = period_name
    )
}

calperum_cloud <- bind_rows(
  make_cloud(cpr_pre,    "Pre-fire"),
  make_cloud(cpr_during, "During Fire / Recovery"),
  make_cloud(cpr_post,   "Post-fire")
) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c(
    "Pre-fire",
    "During Fire / Recovery",
    "Post-fire"
  )))

# Build fitted lines 
calperum_fitted <- calperum_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    period  = period,
    vpd_mid = seq(vpd_at_peak, 6, by = 0.05),
    fitted  = intercept + slope * vpd_mid
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c(
    "Pre-fire",
    "During Fire / Recovery",
    "Post-fire"
  )))

# Raw daily point cloud per period 
calperum_raw <- bind_rows(
  cpr_pre    %>% mutate(period = "Pre-fire"),
  cpr_during %>% mutate(period = "During Fire / Recovery"),
  cpr_post   %>% mutate(period = "Post-fire")
) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  mutate(
    cap      = quantile(GPP, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
    GPP      = ifelse(GPP > cap, NA, GPP),
    gpp_norm = GPP / max(GPP, na.rm = TRUE),
    period   = factor(period, levels = c(
      "Pre-fire",
      "During Fire / Recovery",
      "Post-fire"
    ))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
# Faceted plot with raw cloud + binned points + fitted line
p_cpr_facet <- ggplot() +

  # Raw daily scatter — background layer, very transparent
  geom_point(
    data  = calperum_raw,
    aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = period),
    size  = 0.3, alpha = 0.08
  ) +

  # Binned 95th percentile points — more visible on top
  geom_point(
    data  = calperum_cloud,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = gpp_norm, colour = period),
    size  = 2, alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Fitted slope line
  geom_line(
    data      = calperum_fitted,
    aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = period),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  # VPD peak threshold marker
  geom_vline(
    data     = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak, colour = period),
    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Slope and threshold annotation
  geom_text(
    data = calperum_slopes %>% filter(!is.na(slope)),
    aes(label  = paste0("β = ", round(slope, 3),
                        "\nVPD peak = ", round(vpd_at_peak, 2), " kPa"),
        colour = period),
    x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
    size = 3, fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(~ period, ncol = 3) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = period_colours) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
  labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),  # period titles
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),                 # VPD and GPP labels
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 10)                  # tick numbers
  )

print(p_cpr_facet)
```
